crossRefs.note: Yahweh’s word that came to Micah the Morashtite in the days of Jotham, Ahaz, and Hezekiah, kings of Judah, which he saw…
But one stood up in the council, a Pharisee named Gamaliel, a teacher of the law, honored by all the people, and…
